# Mersennet Documentation

> Mersennet is a zero-knowledge, EVM-equivalent Layer 1 blockchain with account-level privacy, a native on-chain order book (PrimeOrders, precompile 0x0100), and every block proven with SP1 and verifiable on Ethereum via Groth16. Chain ID: 131071. Token: MRSN.

## Getting Started

- [What is Mersennet?](/getting-started/overview): Overview of the chain's capabilities and architecture.
- [Network Information](/getting-started/network-info): RPC endpoints, Chain ID, WebSocket, deployed contracts.
- [Wallet Setup](/getting-started/wallet-setup): How to configure MetaMask or PrimeXDC Wallet.
- [Get Testnet MRSN](/getting-started/faucet): How to use the faucet to get test tokens.
- [First Transaction](/getting-started/first-transaction): Send your first transaction and deploy a contract.

## Privacy

- [Privacy Overview](/privacy/overview): Shielded accounts, ZK risk checks, selective disclosure, verifiable state.
- [Shielded Accounts](/privacy/shielded-accounts): Notes, commitments, nullifiers, shield/unshield.
- [ZK Risk Checks](/privacy/zk-risk-checks): Margin and solvency proven without revealing positions.
- [Selective Disclosure](/privacy/selective-disclosure): Viewing-key grants for auditors and exchanges.
- [Note Scanning](/privacy/note-scanning): Owner-side balance reconstruction.
- [State Proofs](/privacy/state-proofs): SP1 block proofs, Groth16 Ethereum bridge, light clients.
- [Migration](/privacy/migration): Hard-fork migration of transparent balances into notes.

## Architecture

- [Consensus Mechanism](/architecture/consensus): HotStuff-2 BFT Proof-of-Stake, proposer rotation, finality, slashing.
- [Node Architecture](/architecture/node-architecture): Crates, engine pipeline, precompiles (0x0100, 0x0200, 0x0201, 0x0202, 0x0300).
- [PrimeOrders CLOB](/architecture/prime-orders): Native on-chain order matching precompile at 0x0100.
- [Token Economics](/architecture/tokenomics): 1B max supply, halving schedule, allocation.
- [EVM Compatibility](/architecture/evm-compatibility): Shanghai-level EVM; standard RLP transactions accepted.

## Key Facts

- Chain ID: testnet 131071 (0x1FFFF) · mainnet 8191 (0x1FFF) · privacy testnet compose 7920
- Token: MRSN (18 decimals)
- Max Supply: 1,000,000,000 MRSN
- Block Time: ~1 second (default)
- Consensus: Proof-of-Stake, HotStuff-2 BFT (2-phase, ~2/3 stake finality)
- EVM Level: Shanghai (standard RLP legacy/EIP-2930/EIP-1559 transactions accepted)
- Privacy: shielded accounts (note/nullifier model), threshold-encrypted orders, SP1-proven state
- RPC: http://46.225.30.187:8545
- WebSocket: ws://46.225.30.187:8546
- Block Explorer: https://explorer.mersennet.com
- Faucet: https://faucet.mersennet.com
- GitHub: https://github.com/mersennet/mersennet
